mapper.sql: select b.id, b.title, b.author, b.description, b.status, b.del_flag, b.create_by, b.create_time, b.update_by, b.update_time, b.remark, lr.id last_read_chapter_id, lr.chapter_name last_read_chapter_name, b.last_read_time, (select fc.id from px_book_chapter fc where fc.book_id = b.id and fc.create_by = b.create_by and fc.del_flag = '0' order by fc.chapter_no asc, fc.id asc limit 1) first_chapter_id, (select count(1) from px_book_chapter c where c.book_id = b.id and c.del_flag = '0') chapter_count from px_book b left join px_book_chapter lr on lr.id = b.last_read_chapter_id and lr.book_id = b.id and lr.create_by = b.create_by and lr.del_flag = '0'
mapper.select: where b.id = #{id} and b.create_by = #{userId} and b.del_flag = '0'
mapper.insert: insert into px_book(title, author, description, status, del_flag, create_by, create_time, remark) values(#{title}, #{author}, #{description}, #{status}, '0', #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{remark})
mapper.update: update px_book set title = #{title}, author = #{author}, description = #{description}, status = #{status}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = #{updateTime}, remark = #{remark} where id = #{id} and create_by = #{updateBy} and del_flag = '0'

update px_book b join px_book_chapter c on c.id = #{chapterId} and c.book_id = b.id and c.create_by = #{userId} and c.del_flag = '0' set b.last_read_chapter_id = c.id, b.last_read_time = now() where b.create_by = #{userId} and b.del_flag = '0'
